raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.1.1"
  # dependencies
  lal_version: 8.0.0
  swig_version: 4.4.1

recipe:
  name: lalframe-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/lalsuite/lalframe-${{ version }}.tar.xz
    sha256: d3743ba030845140c6bd95f9dc2e05d4803d01dabaed67bf4b743a141b6afccb

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win

outputs:

  # -- Staging -----------------------

  - staging:
      name: lalframe-c-build
    build:
      script: build.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - python >=3.6
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
      host:
        - ldas-tools-framecpp
        - libframel
        - liblal ${{ lal_version }}.*

  # -- Packages ----------------------

  - package:
      name: liblalframe
    inherit: lalframe-c-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - include/lal/
        - lib/liblalframe*
        - lib/pkgconfig/lalframe*.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalframe", upper_bound="x") }}
      run_constraints:
        - lalframe >=1.5.3
        - python-lalframe >=1.5.3
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - lalframe
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lalframe
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Frame Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Frame Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
        applications that use the LAL Frame library.

  - package:
      name: python-lalframe
    inherit:
      from: lalframe-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/
      script: build-python.sh
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalframe so that we ensure a unique
        # python-lalframe build string for each unique liblalframe build
        use_keys:
          - ldas_tools_framecpp
          - libframel
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalframe", exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalframe", exact=True) }}
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalframe
            - lalframe.frread
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest >=4.0
        files:
          source:
            - test/python/
            - test/F-TEST-600000060-60.gwf
        script:
          - python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Frame Library Python bindings
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Frame Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the Python bindings of the LALFrame C libraries
        and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lalframe` package.

  - package:
      name: lalframe
    inherit:
      from: lalframe-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - bin/
        - etc/lalframe-user-env.*
        - share/man/
      script: install-bin.sh
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalframe so that we ensure a unique
        # lalframe build string for each unique liblalframe build
        use_keys:
          - ldas_tools_framecpp
          - libframel
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - sed
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalframe", exact=True) }}
        - liblal ${{ lal_version }}.*
        # needed by ./configure
        - numpy
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalframe", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalframe", exact=True) }}
        - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalframe
          pip_check: false
      - files:
          source:
            - test/F-TEST-600000000-60.gwf
        script:
          - lalframe_version --verbose
          # the user environment script rewrites PATH, so check that it still works
          - bash -c '. "${PREFIX}/etc/lalframe-user-env.sh" && lalframe_version'
          - lalfr-cksum test/F-TEST-600000000-60.gwf
          - lalfr-cut H1:LSC-AS_Q test/F-TEST-600000000-60.gwf > /dev/null
          - lalfr-dump test/F-TEST-600000000-60.gwf
          - lalfr-paste test/F-TEST-600000000-60.gwf > /dev/null
          - lalfr-split test/F-TEST-600000000-60.gwf
          - lalfr-stat test/F-TEST-600000000-60.gwf
          - lalfr-stream --channel H1:LSC-AS_Q --start-time 600000000 --duration 0.01 --frame-glob test/F-TEST-*.gwf
          - lalfr-vis --channel H1:LSC-AS_Q --start-time 600000000 --duration 0.01 --frame-glob test/F-TEST-*.gwf
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Frame Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Frame Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the runtime tools.

about:
  summary: LSC Algorithm Frame Library
  description: |
